name: Reli3D
summary: Amazon brand selling engineering filaments: low-warp and standard PP, carbon-fibre PP, PC-ABS, PAHT-CF nylon and a water-soluble support, at about $30-35/kg for 1 kg spools and $52-66/kg for 0.5-0.7 kg spools. The Amazon seller is a Guangzhou trading company; extruder unknown.

product_lines.name: PAHT-CF (Nylon Carbon Fiber)
product_lines.notes: 500 g, $25.99 ($51.98/kg); the base polyamide is not stated beyond 'PAHT'.

product_lines.name: PLA Water Soluble Support
product_lines.notes: 500 g, $32.99. The title says PLA but water-soluble; the actual polymer (PVA, BVOH or a modified PLA) is not stated, so no filament id is asserted.
